nf3c2bc7cb4.headline: Iran Contradicts Trump, Says Hormuz Is Blocked
nf3c2bc7cb4.summary: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will stay blocked until U.S. conditions are met, countering President Trump's claim of control. Ship traffic has plummeted and oil prices have been affected.

n594e2d0369.summary: Global oil reserves have begun to decline rapidly as ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains very limited. The IEA has warned of the situation.

n2f06d8d81d.why: Shein and Temu are major online fast-fashion and marketplace rivals competing for the same consumers. Legal disputes affect their costs and product listings.

n0351ef1cdc.headline: Foreign banks eye bigger Vietnam role as growth ambitions fuel funding crunch
n0351ef1cdc.summary: Foreign banks are seeking a larger foothold in Vietnam by extending hard-currency loans to local lenders. The move comes as growth ambitions are fuelling a funding crunch.
n0351ef1cdc.why: Foreign lenders supply foreign-currency funding that local Vietnamese banks use to finance growth. Shifts in this lending affect credit conditions in a fast-growing emerging economy.

n866b3ec000.summary: Salvage work is underway for the Caroline Bezengi, which ran aground carrying an estimated 800,000 barrels of Russian oil. The vessel is under international sanctions and lies near a marine nature reserve.
n866b3ec000.why: Sanctioned tankers carrying Russian crude are a sensitive part of global oil trade, and spills or groundings can affect shipping routes, insurance and oil supply sentiment.

n34297fe396.summary: The natural gas supply situation in Latvia is currently stable, the Ministry of Climate and Energy said. Heat supply companies will be ready for the next heating season.
n34297fe396.why: Natural gas supply security affects heating costs for households and the operating costs of district heating companies.
